SELECT ls.id, ls.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_name AS schoolName, ls.offering_id AS offeringId, o.offering_code AS offeringCode, c.course_name AS courseName, ls.session_date AS sessionDate, ls.start_time AS startTime, ls.end_time AS endTime, ls.classroom, ls.status, lr.id AS activeLeaveRequestId, lr.status AS activeLeaveStatus, lr.reason AS activeLeaveReason FROM lesson_session ls JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = ls.offering_id AND o.school_id = ls.school_id JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id AND c.school_id = o.school_id JOIN school s ON s.id = ls.school_id JOIN enrollment e ON e.school_id = ls.school_id AND e.offering_id = ls.offering_id AND e.student_id = #{studentId} JOIN student_guardian sg ON sg.student_id = e.student_id AND sg.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND sg.is_active = TRUE JOIN guardian g ON g.id = sg.guardian_id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN sys_user gu ON gu.id = g.user_id AND gu.school_id = ls.school_id AND gu.enabled = TRUE LEFT JOIN leave_request lr ON lr.session_id = ls.id AND lr.student_id = e.student_id AND lr.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') WHERE ls.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND o.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'CLOSED') AND TIMESTAMP(ls.session_date, ls.start_time) > #{now} AND e.enrolled_at <= TIMESTAMP(ls.session_date, ls.start_time) AND ( e.canceled_at IS NULL OR e.canceled_at >= TIMESTAMP(ls.session_date, ls.start_time) ) ORDER BY ls.session_date, ls.start_time, ls.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_request ( school_id, offering_id, session_id, student_id, guardian_id, reason, status, submitted_by, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{record.schoolId}, #{record.offeringId}, #{record.sessionId}, #{record.studentId}, #{record.guardianId}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', #{submittedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) )

mapper.select: SELECT FROM leave_request lr JOIN school s ON s.id = lr.school_id JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = lr.offering_id JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id JOIN lesson_session ls ON ls.id = lr.session_id JOIN student st ON st.id = lr.student_id JOIN guardian g ON g.id = lr.guardian_id JOIN sys_user submitter ON submitter.id = lr.submitted_by LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON reviewer.id = lr.reviewed_by LEFT JOIN sys_user withdrawer ON withdrawer.id = lr.withdrawn_by WHERE lr.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM leave_request lr JOIN school s ON s.id = lr.school_id JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = lr.offering_id JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id JOIN lesson_session ls ON ls.id = lr.session_id JOIN student st ON st.id = lr.student_id JOIN guardian g ON g.id = lr.guardian_id
JOIN student_guardian current_binding ON current_binding.student_id = lr.student_id AND current_binding.guardian_id = lr.guardian_id AND current_binding.is_active = TRUE
JOIN sys_user submitter ON submitter.id = lr.submitted_by LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON reviewer.id = lr.reviewed_by LEFT JOIN sys_user withdrawer ON withdrawer.id = lr.withdrawn_by
AND lr.school_id = #{schoolId} AND o.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND lr.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND lr.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND lr.session_id = #{sessionId} AND lr.status = #{status}
ORDER BY lr.submitted_at DESC, lr.id DESC

SELECT ar.id, ar.school_id AS schoolId, ar.offering_id AS offeringId, ar.session_id AS sessionId, ar.attendance_id AS attendanceId, ar.correction_request_id AS correctionRequestId, ar.student_id AS studentId, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.full_name AS studentName, ar.old_status AS oldStatus, ar.new_status AS newStatus, ar.old_remark AS oldRemark, ar.new_remark AS newRemark, ar.old_recorded_by AS oldRecordedBy, old_recorder.display_name AS oldRecordedByName, ar.old_recorded_at AS oldRecordedAt, ar.changed_by AS changedBy, changer.display_name AS changedByName, ar.changed_at AS changedAt FROM attendance_revision ar JOIN student st ON st.id = ar.student_id JOIN sys_user old_recorder ON old_recorder.id = ar.old_recorded_by JOIN sys_user changer ON changer.id = ar.changed_by WHERE ar.attendance_id = #{attendanceId} ORDER BY ar.changed_at, ar.id
